name: fleet-rollout-smoke
title: Roll the durable lane out to the 9 fleet consumers with a per-repo smoke PR
description: Deploy the routed review lane to the nine fleet consumer repositories, of which one (sd-github-review, the router itself) currently carries the discovery descriptor and durable review workflow and eight carry neither. For each undeployed repository install the setup descriptor and the workflow_dispatch sd-review.yml lane through this repository's consumer installer (scripts/install-consumer.mjs), not the sd-ai-command-pack fleet refresh, which installs the pack rather than the lane. Then open one smoke pull request per repository and confirm the sd-github-review/receipt Check Run is published against it. --route-mode is required per consumer and has no default.
creator: sdelmas
